blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Tempo block 30043787, pathUSD reported paused() = false and transferPolicyId() = 2. The TIP-20 specification and implementation grant PAUSE_ROLE the ability to halt transfers, allow DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to replace the transfer policy, and grant BURN_BLOCKED_ROLE the ability to burn tokens from accounts blocked by the active policy. The current unpaused state does not remove those privileged transfer-control paths, so direct restriction/freeze capability is established.
